title: The Protocol of Marseille's old port
author: Jude Reyes
blurb: Dominic Thornbury, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
